subject.title: [Bug]: Sandbox prune does not clean up workspace directory

question: Should maintainers adopt the linked conflicting fork PR, replace it with a narrow OpenClaw repair, or fold this focused prune cleanup into the broader sandbox lifecycle issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but there is already an open conflicting fork PR and the cleanup deletes local sandbox state, so maintainers should pick the canonical implementation route before automation creates another branch.

options.title: Replace With Narrow Repair
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and land a focused OpenClaw PR that removes only eligible non-shared sandbox workspaces with regression tests.

options.title: Adopt The Fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer resolve the fork PR conflicts and review it as the canonical fix candidate for this issue.

options.title: Fold Into Lifecycle Work
options.body: Keep this issue as context and let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98516 define the permanent owner-scoped sandbox cleanup contract first.

recommendation.title: Replace With Narrow Repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and land a focused OpenClaw PR that removes only eligible non-shared sandbox workspaces with regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history and the broader related lifecycle issue point most strongly to steipete for the implementation-route decision.
